purpose: Exercise the restart and abandonment paths of measurement/step.c, which theta = 2^-60 never reaches in a measured sample
builds: measurement/step.c compiled with -DADDER_BITS=6 -DB=4096 plus the flags below, linked with the pinned blst as in run.sh; walk_ref.py run with the same values in the environment (ADDER_BITS, B, DP_BITS, CAP_PERIODS)
inputs: walk_ref.py gen with ADDER_BITS=6 B=4096, seed 7 (64 adders, 4096 starts, 1024 spare starts)
